hook.text: Thirteen years for GTA Six was never your mistake. It was your plan, because you're Rockstar Games.

beats.text: First, you release GTA Five, and it sells over two hundred million copies. Then GTA Online keeps the money coming for years, so you never have to rush GTA Six.
Now you need hype. So in December 2023 you drop one trailer, and it gets ninety million views in twenty four hours, beating MrBeast's record.
Still not enough? Trailer two pulls four hundred seventy five million views in one day across every platform. Nothing in entertainment had ever done that.
Then you hit the wall. The game isn't ready. So you delay GTA Six to May, then again to November nineteenth, and the internet loses its mind.
But the wait only made it bigger. Eighty dollars, and preorders still beat expectations. And starting today, the preload needs up to two hundred twelve gigabytes.
Now you've won. In nine days, millions of players vanish into Vice City at the same time. And GTA Seven? Probably another
